# Cost-Governance Dashboard
Token cost, savings, and quality for the agentic app. Data source: `costgov.request` events emitted by the prototype to Application Insights (`traces` table, `customDimensions`). This is the production counterpart of the local `dashboard.html`.

content.query: traces | where message == 'costgov.request' | extend cost = todouble(customDimensions.cost_usd), latency = todouble(customDimensions.latency_ms), cache_hit = toint(customDimensions.cache_hit) | summarize ['Total cost $'] = round(sum(cost), 4), ['Avg latency ms'] = round(avg(latency), 0), ['Cache hit %'] = round(100.0 * sum(cache_hit) / count(), 0), ['Requests'] = count()
content.title: Run KPIs

content.query: traces | where message == 'costgov.request' | extend cost = todouble(customDimensions.cost_usd), model = tostring(customDimensions.model) | summarize ['cost $'] = round(sum(cost), 5) by model | order by ['cost $'] desc
content.title: Cost by model served

content.query: traces | where message == 'costgov.request' | extend cost = todouble(customDimensions.cost_usd), tenant = tostring(customDimensions.tenant) | summarize ['cost $'] = round(sum(cost), 5), requests = count() by tenant | order by ['cost $'] desc
content.title: Cost by tenant (chargeback)

content.query: traces | where message == 'costgov.request' | extend cost = todouble(customDimensions.cost_usd), difficulty = tostring(customDimensions.difficulty), model = tostring(customDimensions.model) | summarize cost = round(sum(cost),5), requests = count() by difficulty, model | order by difficulty asc
content.title: Cost by difficulty and model (is cheap serving hard traffic?)

content.query: traces | where message == 'costgov.request' | extend cost = todouble(customDimensions.cost_usd) | summarize ['cost $'] = round(sum(cost),5) by bin(timestamp, 5m) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Spend over time
